description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android Wearable application. It manages the activity lifecycle, handles ambient and active display modes, and updates the user interface periodically using Handlers and AlarmManager. The class demonstrates best practices for power-efficient updates suitable for wearable devices, including updating UI elements such as time and status, and switching between ambient and active modes with appropriate visual adjustments.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An activity for Android Wear that showcases ambient support, periodic UI updates, and power management techniques for wearable devices.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up layout, and configures stub layout inflation and UI components.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents, typically used to refresh UI when activity is re-launched via AlarmManager.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up handlers and alarms to prevent leaks when activity is destroyed.

methods.name: onEnterAmbient
methods.description: Prepares the UI for ambient mode, adjusting visual attributes for power efficiency.

methods.name: onUpdateAmbient
methods.description: Updates the UI while in ambient mode, invoked periodically or via alarm.

methods.name: onExitAmbient
methods.description: Restores UI to active mode settings when leaving ambient mode.

methods.name: refreshDisplayAndSetNextUpdate
methods.description: Updates the UI elements and schedules the next update depending on current mode.

methods.name: loadDataAndUpdateScreen
methods.description: Populates UI elements with current data, like time and mode, also updating draw count.
